proposal.description: When strikes clear, Red_LED1 stays lit to the end of the current lit blink half-period, to 'finish the pattern cleanly', instead of going dark on the next clock
proposal.reason: Suppose clean_run_target cycles clear strike_level while the blink is in its lit half. Red_LED1 then stays high for up to a whole half-period (125 ms) after strike_level reaches zero, when it should drop one clock later.

proposal.description: Running indication is held dark during a retry soft-start while strikes are outstanding, as if a retry were not yet 'running', though Green must be lit in S_SS and S_RUN whenever no fault is live
proposal.reason: After a hiccup, the converter retries through S_SS with strike_level non-zero and no live fault. Green_LED stays dark for that whole soft-start and lights only on entry to S_RUN, when it should be lit for the whole retry soft-start too.
